faq.question: Can Indian students study Architecture in Finland in English?
faq.answer: Yes. Both Aalto University and the University of Oulu offer full Master of Science in Architecture programmes taught 100% in English for international students holding a recognised Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch).

faq.question: Is a design portfolio mandatory for Architecture admission in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. The design portfolio is the single most critical component of the admission evaluation. Applicants must submit a curated PDF portfolio featuring 4 to 6 diverse architectural design projects showcasing sketches, technical drawings, 3D renderings, and design concepts.

faq.question: How long does it take to study Architecture in Finland?
What is the tuition fee for Architecture in Finland for Indian students?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees are €14,000 per year at the University of Oulu (approx ₹15.2 lakh) and €20,000 per year at Aalto University (approx ₹21.7 lakh). Generous merit-based scholarships covering 50% to 100% of tuition are available.

faq.question: Is an Architecture degree from Finland recognized across Europe?
faq.answer: Yes. The Master of Science in Architecture from Aalto University and the University of Oulu directly conforms to European Union Directive 2005/36/EC, ensuring professional architect recognition across all 27 EU member states.
